description: `--logHeapUsage` under Jest 30.5.2 (B23d A4): each file's header gains ` (<n> MB heap size)`, the file's heap in whole megabytes. The number differs between runs and machines, so it is masked; the line's shape is the claim. Three files (one fails), one Jest worker. The kept lines are sorted, because the files' order follows their sizes and timings. A black-box run.
